evaluation_script: "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport base64\nimport zipfile\nimport tempfile\n\n# Arguments: zip_filename\nzip_filename = sys.argv[1]\n\ndef process_multifile_zip():\n    try:\n        # Decode base64 content and extract zip\n        with open(zip_filename, 'rb') as f:\n            zip_data = base64.b64decode(f.read())\n        \n        # Write zip file to temporary location\n        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.zip', delete=False) as temp_zip:\n            temp_zip.write(zip_data)\n            temp_zip_path = temp_zip.name\n        \n        # Extract zip contents\n        with zipfile.ZipFile(temp_zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref:\n            file_list = zip_ref.namelist()\n            zip_ref.extractall('.')\n        \n        print(f'Found {len(file_list)} files in zip:')\n        \n        total_chars = 0\n        for filename in sorted(file_list):\n            if os.path.exists(filename):\n                with open(filename, 'r') as f:\n                    content = f.read().strip()\n                    print(f'{filename}: {content}')\n                    total_chars += len(content)\n        \n        print(f'Total characters: {total_chars}')\n        \n        # Cleanup\n        os.unlink(temp_zip_path)\n        for filename in file_list:\n            if os.path.exists(filename):\n                os.unlink(filename)\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f'Error: {str(e)}')\n\nprocess_multifile_zip()"
evaluation_script_lang: "/usr/bin/python3"
